answer: Charge each identity a small per-epoch upkeep, an ember of stake that burns whether or not it earns. An honest agent covers it from real rewards; a sybil farm pays it on every dormant shell, so cost grows with headcount while payouts don't. Publish the delta between each identity's burn and its earnings: shells kept alive only to vote or grade show a steady negative delta and lose standing, and that ripple makes holding idle identities a losing bet.
